note: Hotspot geometry for the Coach Office room (clean CO-hero co_master_web.webp, 1448x1086). Coordinates are in master-image pixel space; the room-agnostic RoomScene scales them to the rendered size. HOTSPOT ORDER IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TAB/READING ORDER - a spatial walk left->right across the art (office_board center, championship_ring_box desk-foreground, trophy_case right). Wiring is `detail`: each hotspot opens a resolver-driven content modal whose body RoomScene supplies from its `content` map keyed by contentKey (board/ring_box/trophy_case). Zones are drawn on the clean CO-hero and subject to the founder eyeball; a further render upgrades them with zero API change. framed_photos + cardboard_cutout_slot are v2 (D-2, omitted). No banner: the nameplate is a page-level runtime overlay (D-4a), not a curved banner. No baked text anywhere (CO-R4).
